decisions_required: D1: may mythos_intelligence store raw third-party personal data (name/email/phone) for contacts? control-plane-schema.sql currently forbids it outright, and Google Contacts import is impossible without it.

D4: may a disputed fact be auto-resolved by scope precedence, or only by explicit human instruction?

decisions: OWNER_DECISION_A (2026-08-12): a rate-limited request writes an audit event and nothing else - no submission, observation, fact or media row. Recorded in IDA3_INGESTION_ARCHITECTURE.md section 14.1.

OWNER_DECISION_B (2026-08-12): idempotency is resolved before the rate-limit check and a replay consumes no quota. Enforced order is validate, server-derived identity, idempotency, rate limit, submission flow. Recorded in IDA3_INGESTION_ARCHITECTURE.md section 14.1.

stages.title: Private admin-only ingestion route — thin HTTP adapter over the IDA-3B service

tests.note: all re-run against the post-merge tree; merge was a true fast-forward

decisions: TRANSPORT (2026-08-12): multipart/form-data per section 12, derived not invented - IDA-3B submit() consumes envelope and media in one atomic call, and section 12 explicitly rejects JSON-with-base64, so raw-body cannot carry both.

ACTOR_REF (2026-08-12): context.actor_ref is the raw bearer TOKEN, matching the established IDA-3B contract; ingestion resolves it internally and persists only the usr_* identity. Passing req.mythosIdentity would double-resolve and always yield INVALID_ACTOR_REF.
stages.next_stage: IDA-3E (admin review, NOT STARTED, separate authorisation)

stages.title: Admin review queue for ingested submissions — closes the unreviewed-fact visibility risk

tests.note: all re-run against the post-merge tree; merge was a true fast-forward

resolutions: LEGACY_FACT_BACKFILL (resolved 2026-08-12, owner-authorised): the 8 submission-linked facts created before the gate (18:11-19:29 UTC, gate at 19:54) were pending_review + public. A scoped single-statement UPDATE inside a guarded transaction set access_scope=mythos_private for submission-linked facts whose verification_status is not verified. Exactly 8 rows changed; verification_status untouched; the 55 unrelated unverified+public admin facts and all 3 verified+public facts were left intact by the EXISTS join. Pre-remediation backup idauto-pre-ida3e-backfill.dump, pg_restore verified, sha256 692b5653. Candidate count is now 0 and no submission-linked fact is unreviewed-and-public.
decisions: OWNER_DECISION_C (2026-08-12): community facts ingest as mythos_private; accept sets verification_status=verified AND access_scope=public; reject sets rejected and leaves the scope private. Non-admin read queries are unchanged. Recorded in IDA3_INGESTION_ARCHITECTURE.md section 14.2.

ADMIN_VISIBILITY (2026-08-12): section 6 requires reviewers to see mythos_private evidence, but the IDA-2H review-detail route filters it out and its suite asserts that. IDA-3E adds its own review surface showing full provenance and leaves IDA-2H untouched, reusing writes.reviewObservation for observation decisions.

stages.title: Off-host backup — move ID Auto backup safety outside the VPS failure domain
stages.partial: Tooling delivered and merged (true fast-forward). The stage remains BLOCKED because no off-host copy exists: owner selected Cloudflare R2 but no bucket or token has been provisioned, so no transfer, no remote verification and no restore drill have been performed.

deferral.reason: Cloudflare R2 activation requires billing/payment setup, which the owner has chosen to postpone. This is a scheduling decision, not a technical blocker: the tooling is merged and verified offline, and the local backups remain intact.
resume_steps: 8. Close IDA-3F only after all verification succeeds
deferral.risk_while_deferred: All ID Auto backups remain on the same host as the data they protect, so host or disk loss remains unmitigated. Acceptable only while the data is synthetic; section 11 requires off-host backup before the first stage that accepts real non-admin evidence.

tests.ida-3f-offhost-backup: 30/30 offline (includes the AWS published SigV4 test vector)
tests.local-smoke: stage/verify-local/retention exercised against real backup artifacts as root; dry-run created 0 files; capture-order violation correctly refused; --destructive refused with exit 3
tests.note: all re-run against the post-merge tree

blockers: NO_OFFHOST_DESTINATION_EXISTS: discovery found no usable off-host target already configured. No rclone, restic, borg, aws, s3cmd, mc, gsutil, az, swift or openstack binary is installed and no config for any exists; only generic rsync is present. All three configured SSH hosts resolve to github.com (the notrejour key is a GitHub deploy key), so there is no second server. No NFS/CIFS/sshfs mount and no second disk - only /dev/sda1 plus snap loop devices. Coolify reports s3_storages=0 and scheduled_database_backups=0. Cloudflare R2 is approved in CLOUDFLARE_ARCHITECTURE.md but explicitly not created, and is gated behind INF-CF-6. Provisioning a destination requires owner authorisation, so the stage stopped before selecting one.
